coordinates.note: Campus-grade: the OpenStreetMap object "BR2 Nuclear Reactor" (the reactor building). The SoLid container stood next to the reactor at 6.3-8.9 m from the core; its exact position is not published in the sources read.

depth_mwe.note: The source calls it "minimal"; 8 m.w.e. is the stated figure.
depth_mwe.quote: the minimal 8 m.w.e. overburden of the BR2 building

name: BR2 reactor hall, SCK CEN Mol (SoLid)

summary.plain: The BR2 research-reactor building at the Belgian Nuclear Research Centre in Mol, Belgium, beside which the SoLid detector sat in a shipping container only a few metres from the reactor core.
summary.technical: BR2 reactor building, SCK CEN; SoLid is housed in a lightproof shipping container with 50 cm HDPE shielding under the minimal (about 8 m.w.e.) overburden of the BR2 building. Marked with the building-level OpenStreetMap point.
